title: NextOS community tool
description: One community tool: what NextOS needs to install or run it, plus what its public page at https://www.jonkum.in/community/<slug> needs to be found and read.

slug.description: The page address segment and the folder name. Lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens.

name.description: The tool's name as people say it.

kind.description: What kind of thing this is inside NextOS. A "skin" also needs skin/skin.json and images/preview.svg in its folder. A "script" needs script/files/script.json (+ src/**, build/**); an "extension" needs extension/files/extension.json (+ src, build, panels/**).

runsCode.description: SKIN-SCRIPTS SERIES ADDITION (S2, share): true when this tool ships a program that runs with full, unsandboxed access to the running OS - today, only a skin whose skin/skin.json carries a `script`. A "script" or an "extension" is already understood to be code by its kind alone and does not set this.

summary.description: One plain sentence: the meta description and the listing card.

license.description: An SPDX identifier where one exists (MIT, Apache-2.0, ...).

publishedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the tool first appeared here.

updatedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD, bumped whenever the tool or its page changes. Drives the sitemap.

title.description: Search result and tab title. Defaults to '<name> - <summary>' trimmed.

description.description: Overrides summary as the meta description.

ogImage.description: 1200x630 share image: a path under this tool's folder or an https URL.

command.description: For kind 'command': the one line to run.

url.description: For kind 'url': where to get it.

appId.description: For kind 'app-store': the catalogue app id.

nextos.description: Minimum NextOS version or feature, in words.

accounts.description: Third-party accounts or keys the tool needs.

permissions.description: For apps: the NextOS app permissions it asks for, verbatim.

related.description: Slugs of other community tools worth showing next to this one.
